notes.title: Tofu for everyone!
notes.content:
Hey there tofu friends! We hope you all are in good spirits! 

We just wanted to send a quick message that we will be shifting 'A Tofu Tail' from paid to free-to-play in the near future. This is the only change being applied, so the gameplay and experience will remain the same. This means that the pricing change - while free - will not add any in-app purchases, ads, or other monetization strategies.

Thank you all for your love and support since our game's release, and we hope that more people can now enjoy the experience that we spent so long making into a reality.

Be well, and keep an eye out for any trickster foxes!

~ the alchemedium team

notes.title: A Tofu Tail: Mystery of the Metaverse
notes.content:
A Tofu Tail has been updated with new features!

[previewyoutube=QCqzMFaJ6Mg;full][/previewyoutube]
The world of A Tofu Tail has always planned to be rich with the history of the Kitsune and their world! Now we have published all of this content into the game itself! Join Mr. Tofu on his journey, and learn about all the zany Kitsune characters and their realms as you travel through their worlds.

In this update:[list][*] New Lore Journal to learn more about the world of A Tofu Tail and track Mr. Tofu's progress.
[*] New Achievements Screen added to track your Steam Achievement progress.
[*] Various quality of life enhancements.
[/list]
